[Moonlit Path] For a Limited Time Only!
For more details, please visit the event page or the in-game store.
 
✦Duration✦
Version 3.7 Update - 2026-11-11 11:59 (server time)
 
✦Total Rewards✦
Moonlit Rings Collected Claimable Rewards
Immediately claim Lustrous Tide x1
30 Radiant Tide x1
88 Hsin Cube x1 (Motorbike Accessory)
198 Forging Tide x2
328 Where Dreams Shine Clear x1 (Hsin's Accessory)
450 5-star Weapon Supply Chest: Synth Armament x1
※Open to choose one weapon: Laser Shearer, Radiance Cleaver, Phasic Homogenizer, Pulsation Bracer, or Boson Astrolabe.
680 Transducer x3
980 Selectable 5-Star Resonator x1
※Use to claim one of the three Resonators: Shorekeeper, Carlotta, Phoebe, or 8 Transducers.
※You cannot select a Resonator for whom you've obtained the maximum number of Wavebands.
1600 Cosmetics Set x1
※Full set includes Avatar: Abby Tossing x1, Sigil: Not Even Close x1, Rover Custom Accessory: Not Even Close x1
2200 Cloudview Seat x1 (Collection Item)
※Collection Items can be equipped on the Utility Wheel and used in the Overworld.
 
✦Eligibility✦
- Reach Union Level 5.
- Or complete the combat trial in First Resonance.
- Or access Main Quest Fast Track Event and proceed with the Main Quest until you reach a certain point.
 
✦Event Rules✦
- During the event, obtain Moonlit Rings to unlock and claim rewards.
- Purchase merchandise tagged with the Moonlit Ring icon in the Recommended - Lunite Subscription, Bundles - Special Offers, Outfits, Lunite Purchase, and other sections of the Store to obtain Moonlit Rings.
- When the Moonlit Path event ends, the Moonlit Rings will become invalid and cannot be exchanged for other items.
- If you have any unclaimed rewards when the event ends, you can log in within 30 days afterward to claim them in your Mail. If you fail to log in within 30 days, the rewards will not be reissued. Don't forget to claim them in your in-game mailbox.
- If you make purchases through any non–in-game channel, such as the official website's top-up center, please log in to the game while the event is ongoing to receive your purchases, as well as the corresponding Moonlit Rings. If you log in after the event ends, you will not receive the corresponding Moonlit Rings.
